title: Grateful Dead Live at Capitol Theater on 1970-11-06

ai_review.summary: Audience‑sourced tape captures a scorching Good Lovin' performance – the show shines despite a less‑than‑pristine recording.
ai_review.review: Reviewers rave about the high‑energy delivery, especially the blistering Good Lovin' that drives this 1970 Capitol Theatre show. The recording is an audience tape (no soundboard), so clarity and balance are limited, but fans feel the performance more than makes up for those technical shortcomings.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong positive comments on the musical performance (especially Good Lovin') outweigh the noted recording limitations; multiple reviewers give high marks, yielding a solid overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audience tape with noticeable ambient noise and limited clarity; reviewers wish for a soundboard source, indicating the mix is not pristine.

show_quality.setlist_flow: High‑energy show that builds to an exciting Good Lovin' climax; reviewers describe it as a classic 1970 Dead experience worth downloading.
